name: vulopilot/product-tour
title: Product Tour (VuloPilot)
description: Screenshot tour with groups on the left, numbered hotspots, prev/next arrows and three callout cards. Edit every group, screen, image and hotspot.

intro.default: Real screens from the plugin, not mock-ups. Pick a screen, follow the numbered markers, or click the screenshot to enlarge it.

default.title: Search & AI visibility
default.hint: SEO, GEO, AEO, brand, crawl and schema
